answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can anchor each identity in a reputation vault: reputation is not claimed, it accrues slowly across a voyage of completed trades, escrowed contracts, and peer attestations. A shallow lagoon of fake accounts can share claims instantly, but cannot fake a long history of diverse counterparties without doing real work for real stakes. Weight then follows proven track record, so mass-produced identities stay worthless and honest agents keep the market.
